entries.complaint: Sealed plastic clamshells need scissors or a knife to open, and opening them sends thousands of people a year to the emergency room with cuts
entries.redesign: A paperboard sleeve with a pull-strip perforation, with anti-theft moved to a peg tag or electronic security tag instead of welded plastic

entries.complaint: Push-and-twist caps are painful or impossible for people with arthritis, leading to missed doses or bottles left open
entries.redesign: Keep child resistance but change how it's beaten: a two-button squeeze spaced for adult-length fingers, with a large textured grip, instead of grip strength plus a twist
entries.prior_art: Purdue's Sera two-button container; Arthritis Foundation ease-of-use commendation

entries.complaint: Tiny items arrive in huge boxes stuffed with filler, wasting cardboard and space for recycling
entries.redesign: Boxes cut to the item's size at packing, or padded mailers for small items, and items shipped in their own retail box when it's sturdy enough
entries.prior_art: Amazon's on-demand right-sized boxes; ships-in-own-container program

entries.complaint: Bags and boxes are half empty, so buyers feel they're paying for air, especially after shrinkflation cuts
entries.redesign: Packages sized to the contents, a printed 'contents settle to here' fill line or a clear window, and the price per ounce printed on the front

entries.complaint: The inner bag rips unevenly down the side when opened, spills cereal into the box, and can't be reclosed
entries.redesign: A liner with a laser-scored tear line across the top and a press-to-close zipper, with the box flap shaped to hold it shut

entries.complaint: The zipper tracks don't line up or come apart, and the easy-open tab tears off, so the bag never truly seals
entries.redesign: A slider zipper that forces both tracks together, and a color change between the two tracks that shows when the bag is fully sealed

entries.complaint: Recycling symbols are misread (the Green Dot is taken to mean recyclable), so many people guess or put packaging in the general waste
entries.redesign: A plain-words label for each part, such as 'Box: recycle · Film: general waste · Cap: leave on', in place of codes and look-alike logos
